aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because the primary changed factor is misgrouped as Normal vs Test instead of the report's C2 vs E2 comparison under one CD lot with plasma context.
issues: Primary changed factor contradicts title and purpose: report compares C2 and E2.
Normal/Test appears as within-line condition for tension, not the overall comparison.
C2 and E2 outcome rows are incorrectly attached to a Normal vs Test factor.
Tension pairs are mispaired across lines and do not preserve C2-2A/E2-4B subgroup keys.
LED UV/bonding outcomes rely on header-like rows and need validation against actual data rows.
correctionPlan: Change primary factor to C2 vs E2 with CD lot and plasma C2 as context unless source proves otherwise.
Preserve subgroup keys: line, date, content, CD lot date, IV type, and Normal/Test condition.
Regroup separate VP/CD and function results as C2 vs E2 comparisons.
Regroup tension assay as within-line Test vs Normal subresults under C2 and E2, not cross-line pairs.
Remove or revalidate LED UV/bonding metrics using actual measurement rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they do not sufficiently support the current changed-factor grouping.
